summary: Wrote homily.tex ("All Things Are Ready"), sections/homily/10-homily.tex (spoken body, 1,452 words, seven movements, about 10-12 minutes at parish pace) and sections/homily/90-note.tex (note and nine-entry References). The homily mainly follows the farm-and-merchandise reading of Mt 22:5, joined to the wedding-feast and wedding-garment (charity) readings. The garment is introduced as "Matthew's parable goes on", so the homily still works with the shorter Gospel. It ends with a practical response: name your farm, give something away, and return.
